headline.purpose: States the capture task on the main window.

title.purpose: Names focused workspaces such as recognition results.

body.purpose: Supporting copy, metadata, status, and editable OCR text.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: The capture or completion action; the main-window variant expands to full width and 52px height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid #2563EB; border-radius: 9px; background: #2563EB; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4ED8; border-color: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1E40AF; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { color: #8993A4; background: #E8EBF0; border-color: #D7DCE5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact secondary action for settings, close, and recapture.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 9px 15px; border: 1px solid #C9D1DF; border-radius: 9px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #24324A; font: 600 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F0F4FA; border-color: #AAB6C8; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #E7ECF4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shortcut Information Panel
components.description: A flat tonal strip pairing a reference label with the active global shortcut.
components.css: .ds-shortcut-panel { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #EEF1F6; color: #172033; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-shortcut-badge { padding: 5px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #E7EEFF; color: #1746A2; font: 600 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; }

components.name: OCR Text Editor
components.description: The flexible plain-text result workspace, focused with recognized text selected on open.
components.html:
<textarea class="ds-result-editor">简体中文：屏幕识别
English: Screen OCR</textarea>
components.css: .ds-result-editor { width: 100%; min-height: 180px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #BEC8D8; border-radius: 9px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #101828; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-result-editor:focus-visible { padding: 9px; border: 2px solid #2563EB; outline: none; } .ds-result-editor::selection { background: #BFDBFE; color: #102A56; }

components.name: Tray Menu Item
components.description: A concise native-style tray command with blue-wash selection feedback.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tray-menu"><button class="ds-tray-item">开始框选</button><button class="ds-tray-item">设置</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tray-menu { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 180px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid #D2D8E2; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-tray-item { padding: 8px 28px 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #172033; text-align: left; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-tray-item:hover, .ds-tray-item:focus-visible { background: #E7EEFF; color: #1746A2; outline: none; }

components.name: Capture Spotlight
components.description: A darkened desktop with a restored selection cutout, light-blue boundary, and live dimensions.
components.css: .ds-capture-stage { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 220px; background: rgba(8, 15, 28, 0.62); } .ds-capture-selection { position: absolute; inset: 54px 48px; border: 2px solid #60A5FA; background: #F7F8FA; } .ds-capture-size { position: absolute; left: -2px; top: -34px; min-width: 116px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.92); color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; font: 400 14px 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Screen OCR is a compact, code-led Windows utility whose interface recedes behind a single job: frame text, recognize it locally, and return an editable result. Its visual language is calm and native-adjacent rather than branded or promotional—light neutral ground, dark readable type, compact controls, and one bright blue action channel.

The working windows remain flat and low-noise. Capture mode deliberately reverses that restraint: a translucent navy scrim turns the desktop into a spotlight surface, while a crisp blue outline identifies the live selection. High-contrast mode is not restyled; the application defers to the Windows system theme so user-selected colors and control treatments remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Bright blue reserved for capture, confirmation, selection, and keyboard focus.
Flat neutral surfaces separated by tone and fine borders rather than decoration.
Microsoft YaHei UI throughout for consistent Chinese and Latin rendering.
A screen-spotlight overlay that preserves context while isolating the capture region.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Bright blue communicates capture, copy, selection, or focus; it is not general decoration.

rules.name: The System Contrast Rule
rules.body: When Windows high-contrast mode is active, omit the custom palette and allow the system theme to render the interface.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Keep all interface copy in Microsoft YaHei UI; express hierarchy through size, weight, color, and placement.

rules.name: The Flat Utility Rule
rules.body: Do not add card shadows or floating chrome to ordinary windows; use tone, borders, and spacing to organize the task.

dos: Do keep the capture or completion action visually dominant with the established blue hierarchy.
Do preserve editable original OCR text and the visible recapture path in the result workflow.
Do use compact native controls, keyboard focus borders, and Escape cancellation.
Do preserve the screen-spotlight treatment: dark context, restored selection, blue outline, and live dimensions.
Do defer completely to Windows when high-contrast mode is active.
Do reserve a clear future location for translation results without adding translation controls or claims before the feature ships.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, shadows, oversized cards, or multiple accent colors.
Don't use blue as ambient ornament; it must indicate action, selection, or focus.
Don't replace Microsoft YaHei UI with a web font or a Latin-first display face.
Don't reconstruct document layout inside the result editor; the shipped result is editable plain text.
Don't style over Windows high-contrast preferences.
Don't present translation, history, sync, or recognition-accuracy claims as current capabilities.
